Class EfsFile.Builder<E extends IEfsEvent>

java.lang.Object
org.efs.io.EfsFile.Builder<E>
Type Parameters:
E - efs event type.
Enclosing class:
EfsFile<E extends IEfsEvent>
public static final class EfsFile.Builder<E extends IEfsEvent> extends Object
Fluent builder for creating and, optionally, populating an EfsFile.

Use EfsFile.builder(EfsTopicKey) to obtain a builder for a specific event type and topic, configure the file's dispatcher and limits, and then call build() to create the file. The builder also sets up the CQEngine indexes required for row retrieval and can preload the table from a supplied initializer when the file represents persisted history.

Typical usage is: 


 EfsFile<MyEvent> file =
     EfsFile.<MyEvent>builder(key)
         .dispatcher("mainDispatcher")
         .maxConnections(50)
         .maxRetrievals(250)
         .build();

Builders may also be used to attach an exhaust callback for persistence, provide an initialization supplier for existing rows, or override the clock for testing.

Author:
Charles W. Rapp

      public EfsFile.Builder<E> sizePolicy(EfsFile.SizePolicy policy)

    • initializer

      public EfsFile.Builder<E> initializer(Supplier<Iterator<EfsRow<E>>> initializer)
      Sets efs event file initializer. This supplier provides an event row Iterator used to place initial rows into the event file starting with row zero and up to the latest row.

      The initializer provides an Iterator which, in turn, returns EfsRows in row index sequential, ascending order and publish timestamps in non-descending order. Failure to provide rows meeting these requirements will result in build failing with a EfsFileInitializationException.

      Parameters:
      initializer - initializes efs event file rows.
      Returns:
      this Builder instance.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if initializer is null.

    • build

      public EfsFile<E> build() throws EfsFileInitializationException

      Note: this method is synchronous. If an initializer is set, then this method call blocks until initialization completes. This could be a lengthy process depending on how event row retrieval from persistent store is implemented. This method also synchronizes on the global efs event file map, so building event files is done one at a time in arrival order. Therefore, it is strongly recommended that efs event file creation is performed on application start.

      Returns:
      new EfsFile instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if event file for topic key already exists.
      EfsFileInitializationException - if efs event file initialization fails due to:
      • returned row is null,
      • returned row has index < latest row index, or
      • returned row has publish timestamp < latest row publish timestamp.
